[RCLI.1.5] **`dump-schemas` emits one proto3 file**, unless `--json` asks for
the schemas as data ([RCLI.1.14]). It declares
`syntax = "proto3"` and `package ds.dsc.user.v1`, followed by one message per
`schema` the input declares, named for its `NAME`, its fields numbered from `1`
in declaration order. Each message is the proto source the artefact carries for
that schema ([RDSC.5.8.3]), so a descriptor built from this output matches the
one an engine reads from the `.dsc`. The compiler knows no import path for its
input, so the package is this one for a library's input too, where the artefact's
text adds the path; the message is the same.

Only schemas **declared** in the input are emitted. A schema reached by
`import` is emitted by running `dump-schemas` on the module that declares it,
so a module's output does not change when the import graph around it is
reorganised.

The output is one combined file, so one `protoc` run generates bindings for
the whole set. It goes to standard output, or to the file `-o` names; `-o -`
is standard output.
